title: FTC Action Leads to Industry Bans for Operators of ‘Extended Vehicle Warranty’ Scam
summary: FTC press release announcing a lifetime industry and telemarketing ban against operators of a deceptive 'extended vehicle warranty' scheme.

assertions.quote: AVP made unsolicited calls in which it claimed to be affiliated with vehicle makers

verdicts.note: This is the FTC's own charged and settled finding against this specific operation.

assertions.quote: deceptively claimed its products, which cost thousands of dollars, offered "bumper to bumper" protection

verdicts.note: This is the FTC's own charged and settled finding against this specific operation.

assertions.quote: a lifetime ban from any outbound telemarketing business and from any involvement with extended automobile warranty sales

verdicts.note: The lifetime ban is the literal, court-approved outcome of this settled FTC case.

assertions.quote: called hundreds of thousands of consumers nationwide

verdicts.note: The FTC's complaint and settlement describe a nationwide telemarketing operation reaching a comparable scale of consumers.
